```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse=TRUE,comment='#>')
```

MSGPCA decomposes each observations-by-features matrix into shared and local
programs, $Y_m\approx F_{s,m}W_s^T+F_{l,m}W_{l,m}^T$. Shared loadings are common;
local loadings vary by slice. Loading columns are orthonormal and local loadings
are orthogonal to the shared space. Signs, rotations and allocation ambiguities
remain. Scores are graph-smoothed using sparse shifted-Laplacian solves.

## Inputs and preprocessing

Provide a list of abundance matrices, with common molecular feature identities
in identical order, and corresponding coordinate matrices with matching rows.
Slice sizes and coordinates may differ; no alignment is necessary. The fitter
never normalizes, centers, scales or transforms inputs. Choose preprocessing
appropriate to the assay. Sparse inputs are accepted, but initialization,
residuals and feature covariances can densify.

```{r fit}
library(MSGPCA)
sim <- simulation_gg_blocks(nside=6,Jsp=12,Jmix=24,Jns=12,seed=101)
Y <- lapply(sim$Y_list,log1p)
fit <- MSGPCA(Y,sim$locs_list,n_shared=5,n_local=2,
              lambda_shared=.3,lambda_local=.1,seed=101,verbose=FALSE)
summary(fit)
plot_convergence(fit)
```

## Graphs and diagnostics

Mutual k-NN is default; `graph_type='union'` includes either directed neighbor
relation. `k_shared` and `k_local` specify separate graph sizes, while
`n_shared` and `n_local` specify factor dimensions. Supplied graph entries are
combinatorial Laplacians, or `list(type='adjacency',matrix=A)`. Disconnected
components and isolated vertices are supported. With zero smoothing and no
coordinates, active scores are unregularized. Zero factor dimension disables a
component. Diagnostics include initialization as iteration zero, every complete
penalized objective and increases; the original shared update does not guarantee
monotonic descent. Final scores and loadings always describe the same state.

## Spatial domain detection

```{r clustering}
gmm <- cluster_MSGPCA(fit,5,method='gmm',seed=101)
km <- cluster_MSGPCA(fit,5,method='kmeans',seed=101)
plot_clusters(gmm)
head(gmm$raw[[1]])
head(gmm$refined[[1]])
```

Shared clustering pools scores across slices; local clustering is independent
and its cluster identifiers are not aligned. Scores are not implicitly scaled.
Use `factors=2:5` only with a scientific justification fixed independently of
truth. GMM covariance models are selected by mclust and retained in `gmm_model`.

Refinement is adapted from SpatialPCA (Shang and Zhou, 2022,
doi:10.1038/s41467-022-34879-1), distributed under GPL >=3. It uses one sequential
pass, the focal observation and four (`square`) or six (`hexagon`) neighbors,
with the original strict frequency rule. Ties use observation order. Conventional
Visium uses hexagon. The shape does not validate tissue geometry. Duplicates and
insufficient observations are errors. The default exact k-NN/radius-query implementation retrieves all boundary ties
and resolves them by observation order; a rowwise reference is available via
`engine='reference'`. Memory is linear; worst-case distance work is quadratic. Set `refine=FALSE` to retain raw assignments only.

## Denoising and metafeatures

```{r downstream}
shared <- reconstruct_MSGPCA(fit,'shared',features=1:4)
local <- reconstruct_MSGPCA(fit,'local',features=1:4)
all <- reconstruct_MSGPCA(fit,features=1:4)
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(all[[1]],shared[[1]]+local[[1]])))
scores <- get_scores(fit,'shared')
loadings <- get_loadings(fit,'shared')
head(sort(loadings[,1],decreasing=TRUE))
head(sort(loadings[,1],decreasing=FALSE))
head(sort(abs(loadings[,1]),decreasing=TRUE))
plot_factors(fit,'shared')
plot_factors(fit,'local')
plot_loadings(fit,top=8)
```

Loadings define molecular metafeatures; scores show their spatial activity.
Large loadings do not imply statistical significance. Local factor column numbers
across slices do not imply common programs. Reconstructions remain on the supplied
scale and are not automatically original counts. There is no unobserved-location
prediction method.
